idea-plugin.name: OneClickAPI
idea-plugin.description:
OneClickAPI generates a complete, tested Spring Boot REST API from your @Entity or POJO classes: DTOs, mapper, repository, service, controller, exception handling, OpenAPI docs and tests. Select one class or hundreds and generate them in one go.

What it generates

  • Request/Response DTOs, MapStruct or manual mapper, JPA or CRUD repository, service and REST controller
  • MyBatis mapper interface and XML for plain POJO classes
  • Global exception handling with a standard error format (ApiError) and success envelope (ApiResult)
  • Springdoc / OpenAPI annotations, an OpenAPI 3 spec file and an OpenApiConfig bean
  • Liquibase changelogs (XML or YAML)
  • Image and PDF upload endpoints
  • IntelliJ HTTP Client .http files, ready to run

Tests and coverage

  • Service tests (JUnit 5 + Mockito) and controller tests (MockMvc)
  • Mapper tests: every field and relation id between entity and DTOs
  • Full-stack API tests: real controller, service and repository on an in-memory H2 database, including filters, search and sorting; related rows a request needs are created automatically
  • Optional JaCoCo coverage report added to your build: ./gradlew test prints the coverage of every class and writes an HTML report and the XML report SonarQube reads
  • With all test options on, the generated tests cover about 95% of the lines of the generated code

API standards, one click each

  • Bean Validation derived from the entity (@NotNull, @NotBlank, @Size, @Email)
  • Pagination, sorting, filtering and free-text search on list endpoints
  • Soft delete, audit fields (createdAt / updatedAt), API versioning by path or header
  • Relations exposed as ids, so DTOs never become circular

Safe on real projects

  • Preview before generate: every file, its package and a diff before anything is written
  • Safe re-generation: Skip / Replace / Merge per file; custom-code regions are kept; a report shows what changed
  • Generating again with another package layout reuses shared classes and lists the old files to delete, so Spring never sees duplicate beans
  • Project detection (Maven/Gradle, Spring Boot 2, 3 and 4, JPA/MyBatis, MapStruct, Lombok, Liquibase/Flyway) and missing dependencies added to your build file, followed by a Gradle/Maven reload
  • Team presets in .oneclickapi.yml: Standard Spring Boot CRUD, Clean Architecture, Enterprise API, MyBatis Backend, or your own

How to use

  1. Right-click an @Entity or POJO class (or select several) in the Project view or the editor
  2. Choose Generate API
  3. Pick a preset or the options you want, check the preview, and generate

Works with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and every newer release.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0

New generator engine.

  • New: preview before generate, with a diff per file
  • New: safe re-generation (Skip / Replace / Merge, custom-code regions kept) and a generation report
  • New: service, controller, mapper and full-stack API tests (H2), exception-handler tests and .http files
  • New: optional JaCoCo coverage report with per-class coverage after ./gradlew test
  • New: OpenAPI annotations, spec and config; pagination, filtering, search, sorting; soft delete; audit fields; API versioning; standard response and error format
  • New: team presets in .oneclickapi.yml
  • New: project detection and automatic dependency additions; Spring Boot 4 support
  • New: Generate API directly in the Project view and editor right-click menus
  • Fixed: duplicate Spring beans when generating again with another package layout
  • Fixed: by-id endpoints failing when the project is not compiled with -parameters
  • Fixed: date filters rejected with 400 on Spring Boot 2
  • Fixed: CRUD Repository option not compiling
  • Changed: Liquibase changelogs are generated in XML and YAML (SQL and JSON are no longer offered)
